title: A70 Story Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A70_story_register.csv (Phase 3, US-S7-02). Each row is a user story derived from promoted A59 claims and/or A62 NFRs. Producer: bsa-story-writer. Consumers: bsa-test-scenario-builder (keys test scenarios off StoryID), bsa-traceability-matrix (walks Story → Claim → Source), bsa-backlog-bridge (ships stories to Jira/Linear/generic). INV-08 applies: every row MUST carry non-empty SourceClaimIDs OR non-empty RelatedNFRIDs (or both) — stories authored from thin air are rejected at the hook layer. INVEST criteria recorded as INVESTStatus column; deferred checks trigger an A51 route.

StoryID.description: Stable identifier STORY-NNN or STORY-XXX-NNN. Category prefix conventions match A51/A59 (e.g., STORY-UX-001 for user-experience-themed rows, STORY-OPS-042 for operations).

Title.description: Short imperative summary (Jira-title sized). Non-empty; max 120 chars keeps it usable as a listable label.

Persona.description: User role / actor this story is authored for. Free-form but non-empty. Typical: 'Triage Agent', 'Delivery Customer', 'Compliance Auditor'. Should match a subject identified upstream in A59 claims.

StoryText.description: Full user story in the canonical shape: 'As a <persona>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>'. The 'so that' clause is strongly recommended but allowed to be absent when the benefit is implicit in the goal. Pattern validates the shape; semantic check (is this actually a story?) is the skill's own responsibility.

AcceptanceCriteria.description: One or more acceptance criteria. Multi-criterion rows join with ';' or newline. Each criterion should be a testable observable state or outcome. This field drives bsa-test-scenario-builder in Sprint 8 — non-testable criteria are blocked upstream via INVESTStatus.

SourceClaimIDs.description: Semicolon/slash-separated list of upstream A59 ClaimIDs this story derives from. May be empty IF RelatedNFRIDs is non-empty. Enforced at the cross-field level (x-bsa-provenance-rules); see INV-08.

RelatedNFRIDs.description: Semicolon/slash-separated list of upstream A62 NFRIDs this story links to. May be empty IF SourceClaimIDs is non-empty. Acceptance criteria for the story should embed measurable targets from any linked NFR.

Priority.description: level-1 = must-have for launch; level-2 = important / next release; level-3 = backlog / nice-to-have. Inherited from the highest source-claim Criticality by default; may be raised (never lowered) by explicit override with A51 rationale.

EstimationHint.description: T-shirt size hint, NOT story points. The plugin does not estimate — this is a coarse producer-hint to help the consuming team triage. 'unknown' is valid and expected when the story is INVEST-deferred on estimability.

INVESTStatus.description: INVEST acceptance state. 'pass' = all 6 criteria met (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable). 'needs-splitting' = S failed (story too large); producer should split. 'needs-estimation' = E deferred (team input required). 'needs-testable-acceptance' = T deferred (acceptance criteria insufficiently concrete). 'needs-negotiation' = N failed (story is a mandate, not negotiable — review with PO). 'escalate' = multiple criteria failed → raise via A51Ref and let the PO triage. Any value other than 'pass' MUST co-populate A51Ref per INV-08+ conventions.

A51Ref.description: Optional A51 cross-reference. REQUIRED (non-empty) whenever INVESTStatus != 'pass' — every INVEST-deferred story must have a decision / action route recorded in A51. Enforced at the cross-field level.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability.

x-bsa-uniqueness-rules._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.12 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_uniqueness_rules. Schema-agnostic generic extension (see v1.2.10 CHANGELOG). Stories are per-deliverable; duplicates would break A71.SourceStoryID + A72.StoryID cross-references. Pre-v1.2.12 duplicate StoryIDs were caught only at fixture-review time; v1.2.12 makes it mechanical at hook time.
x-bsa-uniqueness-rules.rationale: Without this rule, duplicate StoryID values could land at promote-gate + silently break every downstream cross-reference. StoryID is the row-identifier.

x-bsa-provenance-rules._comment: INV-08 cross-field rules enforced by bsa-story-writer's own output validator. JSON Schema can't express 'at least one of [A,B] is non-empty' cleanly for CSV-string values that are 'empty' vs 'non-empty' rather than null vs set; the skill and F5 write-time path use this extension as a lookup table.
x-bsa-provenance-rules.rationale: INV-08: stories authored from thin air are drift. Every story must trace back to a claim (from A59) or an NFR (from A62 which itself traces back to claims).

x-bsa-invest-rules._comment: INVESTStatus ≠ 'pass' MUST co-populate A51Ref. Enforced by the skill's own output validator (cross-field rule outside JSON Schema comfort zone for CSV semantics). INVEST expansion: Independent / Negotiable / Valuable / Estimable / Small / Testable.

x-bsa-banned-story-patterns._comment: Common anti-patterns that bsa-story-writer MUST refuse to emit. Documentation only — the skill's own output validator rejects; the schema catches obvious shape-level cases via StoryText pattern + AcceptanceCriteria minLength.
values: As a user I want feature X (no benefit clause, no persona specificity)
As a developer I want clean code (dev-facing; not a user story)
As an admin I want to configure (persona is a proxy; real actor is vague)
The system shall <X> (requirement, not a story — belongs in A62 if quality, A59 if observed fact)
